title: Return Policy
content: Demonstration policy: Most unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery in original packaging. Final-sale items are not eligible for change-of-mind returns. Damaged or incorrect items should be reported within the relevant reporting window in the support FAQ. This is synthetic training data, not a real company policy.

title: Refund Policy
content: Demonstration policy: Refunds are initiated after return inspection and sent to the original payment method. Payment providers may take 5 to 7 business days after initiation. Business days exclude weekends and public holidays. Pending authorisations may disappear without becoming a posted charge.

title: Shipping and Delivery Guide
content: Demonstration guide: Use the order page to track shipments. Tracking may take up to 24 hours to update after dispatch. If tracking remains unchanged for 48 hours after the estimated delivery date, contact support. For a delivered-but-missing parcel, check nearby safe locations and building reception before requesting an investigation.

title: Account Security Guide
content: Never share passwords, reset links, one-time codes, or full payment-card details. Use the official password-reset flow. Report suspicious messages through the official support channel. Support should never request a user's password or one-time authentication code.

title: Human Escalation Procedure
content: Escalate to human support when the answer is not supported by the knowledge base, a payment appears to have been posted twice, an account remains locked after standard recovery, the customer reports a safety or security concern, or the customer expresses high urgency or severe dissatisfaction. Collect only necessary non-sensitive details.
